title: Chapter 2914 - 163: Human Nature_2
content:
Chapter 2914: Chapter 163: Human Nature_2

Mo Hua thought about reorganizing the cultivation paths and tribal systems of the Great Wilderness when an opportunity arose.

But that was a matter for later, with the great disaster looming, there was no leisure time at present.

Gathering the talented witch cultivators together, Mo Hua sat in a high seat within the grand hall, his gaze stern as he spoke:

"The Divine Lord above, grant me the sacred law, impart to me the supreme Great Dao, to save the multitude of the Great Wilderness, this matter is of great importance."

"Next, I will pass on the Divine Lord’s gift, the holy patterns containing the supreme mysteries of the earth, to you all equally."

"I hope you all will embrace the grace of the Divine Lord, diligently study, and work together to stop the disaster in the Great Wilderness, saving the multitude of the Great Wilderness from suffering..."

The sacred laws of the Divine Lord will be equally imparted to all beings...

Astonishment was apparent on all the witch cultivators’ faces.

In the Barbaric Wilderness, the heritage is strict; many things are not passed down to them by the chieftains and elders of their tribes.

Yet now, the Witch Lord is actually going to teach them the legacy of the "Divine Lord".

Such grace in imparting the Dao is akin to being given rebirth by a parent.

Within the grand hall, these reclusive and proud witch cultivators all knelt down, exclaiming loudly:

"May the Divine Lord be eternal."

"Thank the Witch Lord for his immense grace."

"We will go through fire and water for the sake of the Witch Lord without hesitation..."

Mo Hua nodded slightly, then transmitted his carefully organized bone scrolls containing insights on the Thick Earth Ultimate Formation and related laws of the Five Elements Earth Series and Eight Trigrams Gen-series formations.

Mo Hua said, "These ’holy patterns’ are all bestowed by the Divine Lord, closely connected with the earth’s aura of the Great Wilderness."

"Some holy pattern formations might differ from the traditions of the Great Wilderness, but there’s no need to worry about that. Simply put your minds at ease and focus on understanding them."

"The most important of these is the final holy pattern, the First Grade Eleven Pattern holy pattern..."

First Grade Eleven Pattern...

Upon hearing this, all the witch cultivators’ expressions were shaken.

The existence of an "Ultimate Formation" is not covered by the Taoist Court Nine Provinces’ norms, and it far surpasses the understanding of these barbaric Formation Masters.

An ordinary Formation Master might not encounter an "Ultimate Formation" in a lifetime, let alone study and comprehend it.

Even if a Formation Master luckily obtained an Ultimate Formation, if they couldn’t recognize its mysteries or understand it, they might dismiss it as a complex yet useless "strange formation," looking down upon it and not taking it to heart.

But Ultimate Formations are of great importance.

Within an Ultimate Formation lies the laws of heaven and earth, something surpassing the realm of ordinary formations, potentially containing the true principle of formations.

What Mo Hua aims to do now is to first popularize the "Thick Earth Ultimate Formation" in the Barbaric Wilderness.

Allowing this group of witch cultivators to attempt communicating with the Earth Dao Meaning, fostering within them a sentiment of "bearing vast deeds with great virtue" through the influence of the Earth’s Dao Meaning.

To encourage the Formation Masters in the Barbaric Wilderness to transition their faith from "gods" gradually to "heaven and earth."

Especially to first believe in the "earth."

"Man follows the earth." The earth nurtures all things, with enduring virtue, life burgeoning endlessly.

At the onset of the Taoist Heart, the first insights should come from feeling the vitality of the Great Dao within the earth, sensing the nourishing virtue and magnanimity of the earth.

Mo Hua knew in his heart that affairs in the Barbaric Wilderness, especially those involving the fundamental structure of heaven and earth, could not be resolved by him alone.

He had realized this clearly when he was young and the City Lord of Tongxian was building the Five Elements Slaughter Demon Great Formation.

Human power is sometimes exhausted, and personal cultivation is ultimately limited.

If one only seeks personal strength and dominance, seeking to gather the might of heaven and earth alone would suffice.

But if one truly wishes to prove the Dao, to change the world and alter the life charts of all beings, then relying solely on personal Dao and strength is ultimately insufficient.

He needs more people’s assistance.

He needs to change these people’s "Taoist Heart," impart to them the Taoist Skill, and expand it, ultimately uniting the Dao of all beings under heaven and gathering the power of all beings under heaven to truly change the world.

The most important among these people are the Formation Masters, and among all methods, the most critical is formations.

Formations are the most direct reflection of the Dao Laws and the core productivity within all cultivation paths.

And the carriers of formations are the Formation Masters.

Therefore, Mo Hua must pass on his knowledge of formations and incorporate more Formation Masters under his "banner."

To cultivate and pass on more Formation Masters who seek the Great Dao through their Taoist Heart and emulate heaven and earth.

"The First Grade Eleven Pattern holy pattern is beyond secular inheritance and contains the laws of the Divine Way, embodying the will of the Divine Lord."

"You may not comprehend it deeply in the short term, but as long as you are sincere in heart and diligent in thought day and night, eventually, you will understand the Divine Lord’s compassionate intentions and profound meanings, and by then, you will also initially grasp the vitality power of the earth..."

Mo Hua’s tone was sincere, placed great expectations.

All the witch cultivators kowtowed and saluted devoutly, saying, "We respectfully thank the Divine Lord for his blessing, and respectfully thank the Witch Lord for teaching the Dao..."

...

Afterwards, these witch cultivators began to study the Thick Earth Ultimate Formation and many formation diagram systems different from the Great Wilderness as instructed by Mo Hua.

They learned the Thick Earth Ultimate Formation very slowly.

After all, it’s an Ultimate Formation, and even though these witch cultivators are all above Foundation Establishment, with sufficient Divine Sense, it is still extremely difficult to grasp the Earth Dao Meaning due to the limitations of comprehension; it’s not a task for a short time.

This was also within Mo Hua’s expectation.

However, the other ordinary Five Elements Earth Series and Eight Trigrams Gen-series formations, they comprehended very quickly.

And that was enough.

In Mo Hua’s plan, the Thick Earth Ultimate Formation, for now, only he could personally draw out the skeletal framework of the entire pseudo-large formation.

The rest, the numerous intricate details, and the filling laws with Five Elements Earth Series and Eight Trigrams Gen-series formations, were left to these witch cultivators of the Barbaric Wilderness to paint.
